parameters.query:
SELECT id AS code_id, code_hash, attempts,
       (expires_at > now()) AS not_expired
FROM demo_email_codes
WHERE email = $1::citext AND consumed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH consumed AS (
  UPDATE demo_email_codes SET consumed_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND consumed_at IS NULL
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO demo_sessions (email, expires_at, ip)
SELECT $2::citext, now() + interval '2 hours', $3::inet
FROM consumed
RETURNING id::text AS session_id,
          floor(extract(epoch FROM expires_at) * 1000)::bigint AS expires_ms

INSERT INTO demo_leads (email, consent_at, sessions_count, last_ip)
SELECT $1::citext, now(), 1, $2::inet
-- Canonical: someone who unsubscribed me@gmail.com asked not to be
-- contacted, and me+demo@gmail.com is the same inbox. Matching the
-- exact string would keep mailing them under any alias.
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM demo_suppressions
  WHERE email_canonical = public.demo_canonical_email($1::text)
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE
SET last_seen_at = now(),
    sessions_count = demo_leads.sessions_count + 1,
    last_ip = excluded.last_ip

parameters.query:
UPDATE demo_email_codes SET attempts = attempts + 1
WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM demo_email_codes
            WHERE email = $1::citext AND consumed_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)
